items.backtranslation: Food that is put in the pantry
items.problem: "okuceliweyo" means requested/asked for, not planned; the rest of the file uses "ecetywayo" for planned/proposed.

items.key: Food in store follows each crop’s sourced storage conditions. Freezing, drying, fermentation and other processing enter only through dated stock records. A harvest does not automatically create preserved food.
items.draft: Ukutya okugciniweyo kulandela iimeko zokugcina ezinomthombo zesityalo ngasinye. Ukuqandisa, ukomisa, ukubilisa nolunye uqhutyo kungena kuphela ngeerekhodi zokugcina ezinemihla. Isivuno asenzi ngokwaso ukutya okugciniweyo.
items.backtranslation: Stored food follows the storage conditions with a source for each crop. Freezing, drying, boiling and other processing only enter with dated storage records. The harvest does not by itself make stored food.
items.problem: "fermentation" rendered as "ukubilisa" (boiling) - a different preservation method; food-safety meaning changed. Coordinator: "-vundisa" can read as rot or fertilise; used "-vubela" (leaven, ferment) with the English term in brackets until a fluent reviewer confirms.
items.corrected: Ukutya okugciniweyo kulandela iimeko zokugcina ezinomthombo zesityalo ngasinye. Ukuqandisa, ukomisa, ukuvubela (fermentation) nolunye uqhutyo kungena kuphela ngeerekhodi zokugcina ezinemihla. Isivuno asenzi ngokwaso ukutya okugciniweyo.

items.key: Weights recorded as present in each month. Stored, dried, frozen, fermented and processed foods are stocks; they are not a second harvest.
items.draft: Ubunzima obubhalwe njengobukhoyo kwinyanga nganye. Ukutya okugciniweyo, okomisiweyo, okuqandisiweyo, okubilisiweyo nokuqhutywe kuyigcino; ayisosivuno sesibini.
items.backtranslation: Weight recorded as present in each month. Stored, dried, frozen, boiled and processed food is storage; it is not a second harvest.
items.problem: "fermented" rendered as "okubilisiweyo" (boiled) - different preservation method. Coordinator: "-vundisa" can read as rot or fertilise; used "-vubela" (leaven, ferment) with the English term in brackets until a fluent reviewer confirms.
items.corrected: Ubunzima obubhalwe njengobukhoyo kwinyanga nganye. Ukutya okugciniweyo, okomisiweyo, okuqandisiweyo, okuvubelweyo (fermented) nokuqhutywe kuyigcino; ayisosivuno sesibini.

items.problem: "projections" rendered as "amabango" (claims) - wrong term for a projected figure.

items.backtranslation: Leafy vegetables, stalk vegetables and fresh vegetables

items.key: Tilapia pond and reliable dry-season water assumed
items.draft: Ichibi le-tilapia namanzi anokuthenjwa ngexesha lomhlaba owomileyo kuthathelwe ingqalelo
items.backtranslation: A tilapia pond and reliable water in the dry season taken into account
items.problem: "assumed" rendered as "taken into account", and "dry-season" as "dry ground time"; the sentence states an assumption of the example, not that something was considered.
items.corrected: Kucingelwa ichibi le-tilapia namanzi anokuthenjwa ngexesha elomileyo

items.problem: "No frost assumed" rendered as "No frost taken into account" - reads as frost not considered, which reverses the safety assumption of the example (it assumes there is no frost).

items.key: Fictional farm production calendar. Filled marks show the example plan, gold shows stored food, outlined marks show regional references.
items.draft: Ikhalenda yemveliso yefama eqanjiweyo. Iimpawu ezizalisiweyo zibonisa isicwangciso somzekelo, igolide ibonisa ukutya okugciniweyo, iimpawu ezigqunyiweyo zibonisa izalathiso zommandla.
items.backtranslation: Produce calendar of the made-up farm. Filled marks show the sample plan, gold shows stored food, covered marks show region indicators.
items.problem: "outlined marks" rendered as "iimpawu ezigqunyiweyo" (covered/wrapped marks) - wrong description of the legend.
items.corrected: Ikhalenda yemveliso yefama eqanjiweyo. Iimpawu ezizalisiweyo zibonisa isicwangciso somzekelo, igolide ibonisa ukutya okugciniweyo, iimpawu ezinemigca yangaphandle zibonisa izalathiso zommandla.
